# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

**Strategy.** The capability started EMPTY (seed = no system prompt, val 0.400). The local
trajectories carry no traces, so I used the FINAL test traces of the prior run's champion
(`reused_seed_run/run_suite/candidates/cand_0001`) on these same 40 val tasks. Measured there:
0.525 vs the seed's 0.400. It fixes 12 tasks and breaks 7, and all 7 are on our protected list.
So I took that champion as the BASE (copied verbatim) and added BOUNDED, condition-scoped rules:
first for each of the 7 regressions, then for the remaining failures I could diagnose from
init/golden diffs. I added NO new mandatory phases or steps, because the prior run rejected those
four times (cand_0002–0005: extra Phase-1/3 steps, pruning, blanket "always openpyxl",
anti-relitigation).

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Computed from a non-data_only workbook (formula strings read as values) | 52541*, 45707, 57354 | Base Phase-2 snippet loads `wb` without data_only and the model computes from it, so formula cells read as `"=..."`, lookups/comparisons fail, and it loops on identical code | BEHAVIORAL (snippet bug) | fix the point-of-use snippet |
| 2 | Identical resend / invented stdout | 50811*, 52541*, 45707 (loops); 486-17*, 12307, 203-15 (fake output) | Re-saves reset the verify budget, so a resend runs to the turn cap; the model writes "expected output" or several blocks | BEHAVIORAL | turn-protocol rule + "print diagnostics instead of resend" |
| 3 | Excel-semantics mismatches | 9111* (case-insensitive lookup), 534-26* (today), 11276 (TEXT codes), 9391 (blank only on miss) | Python semantics differ from Excel's | KNOWLEDGE | §6 rules |
| 4 | Workbook-derived labels / shape | 50811* (cols by header), 188-39* (header = value kind), 1925 + 203-15 (exact strings), 279-23 (finished-value shape), 59160 (merged headers), 12307 (membership filter), 524-31 (keyword categories), 45944 (row ref stays key) | Model retypes or guesses instead of reading the sheet | KNOWLEDGE | §7 rules |
| 5 | Deletion done as blanking | 28-7* | CONTRACT 3/4 "preserve" pushes the model to blank in place instead of `delete_rows` | CONTRACT (conflict) | CONTRACT exception 5 |
| 6 | Pre-existing formula left in target | 183-8 | An untouched formula cell in answer_position reads empty under hard_no_recalc | CONTRACT | Phase-2 snippet converts leftover formulas |

`*` = protected task (seed passes, base champion failed it). The 7 regressions are 28-7, 52541,
534-26, 9111, 50811, 188-39, 486-17.

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| base | reuse measured champion | prompt.md + task_template.md | copy of prior-run cand_0001 (0.525 on these 40) | it breaks 7 protected tasks; edits R1–R7 target exactly those |
| 1 (+6) | snippet fix | task_template.md Phase 2 | read from `src` (data_only), write to `wb`; convert leftover `=` cells in the target to `ss` cached values; one-line "if an input prints `=...` you read the wrong workbook" | pure bug fix; a correct reader behaves the same |
| 2 | behavioral | task_template.md HOW TO WORK + Phase 3 | only the first block runs, never write expected output; don't resend an identical block, stop or print repr/type of the failing condition's inputs | only affects replies that would be identical/fake |
| 5 | contract | task_template.md CONTRACT 5 | delete whole rows/cols → `delete_rows`/`delete_cols` bottom-up; "delete the values" excluded | triggers 28-7, 374-31, 534-26, 535-20, 409-45 (whole rows/cols); 374-31/534-26/535-20 already use delete_* |
| 3 | knowledge | prompt.md §6 | case-insensitive matching (match only, written value unchanged); today = `datetime.today()`; TEXT format codes + instruction example beats neighbours + apply to whole range; blank-on-miss only on misses | lookup rule touches 11 val tasks; framed as how to *match*, so written values are unchanged |
| 4 | knowledge | prompt.md §7 | columns by header map; header = value kind; text copied from workbook; match finished-value shape (example drops brackets: `(tig) …` → `tig`); merged headers carry; every block has a role / membership filter; keyword "longest wins + print unmatched"; row ref stays key | each is conditional on its trigger |

## Verify-the-fix (the trace each change targets → what it now does on those exact inputs)
- 52541/45707/57354: the trace computed on `wb` (formula strings) and looped. The snippet now names
  `ss` as the read source and prints `was:` from `ss`, and a stray `=` input is explicitly flagged.
- 183-8: the answer_position held a formula the model did not touch → it read empty. The snippet
  loop now rewrites any remaining `=` cell in the target to its cached value before save.
- 28-7: the final code blanked the matching rows. CONTRACT 5 now requires `delete_rows` (shift
  up); the instruction says "delete all rows", so it triggers. 304-35 ("delete the values") does not.
- 534-26: the model took "current month" from the latest date in the data. Golden keeps columns
  ≥ 2020-12 in the Result sheet, so the anchor is a fixed real date, not the data max (2022-06).
  §6 says today = `datetime.today()`.
- 9111: "EVA" vs "Eva" mismatched under Python `==`. §6 normalises keys for matching only.
- 11276: init F3 holds `=TEXT(F4,"DD")`, neighbours hand-typed `TU, W, TH…`, golden `Wed, Thu, Fri…`.
  §6 gives `ddd`=Mon and says the instruction example ("Mon, Wed") beats neighbours, applied to the
  whole row.
- 279-23: the model kept the parentheses (`(tig)`). Golden and the finished cells B17+ read `tig`.
  The §7 example is exactly that shape (taken from the general pattern, not hardcoded to the cell).
- 50811/188-39/1925/203-15/59160/12307/524-31/9391/45944: §7/§6 rules as listed. Diagnosed by
  subagents from the traces plus the golden diff. Medium confidence for 45944 and 12307.
- Placeholder safety: ran `str.format` on the template (comment stripped AND raw) with all 7
  keys → OK. Parsed field set = exactly the 6 required + `max_turns`. The adapter does not
  `.format()` prompt.md (checked adapter.py:1359/1378), so braces in §7 are safe.

## Process & features used
- Subagents: 3 parallel read-only general-purpose agents ("Diagnose regressions group A",
  "Diagnose failures group B1", "B2"). They traced the 7 regressions and the remaining failures
  against init/golden diffs. Their claims were spot-checked by me (534-26, 11276, 9111, 279-23 re-read).
- Prior iterations: RUNMAP is empty and there is no prior_iterations/ (iteration 1). Instead I read the reused
  seed run's JOURNAL / history / rejected record. Learned: cand_0001 accepted; 0002–0005 rejected for
  adding mandatory steps, pruning, a blanket openpyxl rule, and an anti-relitigation clause. None of these
  are re-proposed.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- §1(a) literal-not-formula; §1(b) the date-serial ban; §2 worked-example rule; §4 data_only save trap;
  the Phase-1b calibration block (it fixed tasks in the prior run).
- The Phase-2 `src`/`wb` split (read data_only, write non-data_only).

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- No new mandatory phase/step and no pruning (refuted in the prior run, cand_0002–0005).
- Remaining failures without a clear general root cause from the diff (e.g. 38074, 59358). I did
  not hardcode them.
- No harness-level resend detector: that would be a framework change, so it is logged in FRAMEWORK_IMPROVEMENTS.
